title: Bhakti Saints Ramanujacharya
definition: Ramanujacharya (1017–1137 CE) was a seminal 11th-century philosopher and theologian who founded the Vishishtadvaita (Qualified Non-dualism) school of Vedanta, bridging the gap between Vedic orthodoxy and the devotional Bhakti movement.
importanceInUpsc: Ramanujacharya is a perennial favorite in UPSC Prelims (Art & Culture/History) due to his philosophical contributions, influence on the Vaishnava tradition, and the recent installation of the 'Statue of Equality'.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Bhakti Saints Ramanujacharya.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: General timeline of Medieval Indian History
